column2: Built with your Eco Solutions expert based on your Assessment and Contractor Evaluation results. Focus on no more than 8–10 actions. Better to do 8 things well than 20 things poorly.
ACTION PLAN — Prioritised by Impact and Feasibility

column4: Contractor compliance: Obtain a copy of waste contractor's current DONRE licence and verify it covers all waste types we generate
column8: Licence copy filed; waste types confirmed

column4: Waste separation setup: Set up correctly labelled 3-bin separation system (organic / recyclables / general) at all waste generation points
column8: Bins in place; labels visible; staff know which bin to use

column4: Hazardous waste: Identify all hazardous waste streams (oils, chemicals, batteries). Arrange separate licensed collection
column8: Hazardous waste no longer mixed with general waste

column4: Staff training: Conduct a 30-minute waste handling briefing for all staff. Cover separation rules, bin locations, and what NOT to put in general waste
column8: All staff can identify correct bin for each waste type

column4: Waste tracking: Begin recording monthly waste volumes and disposal costs in the Monthly Dashboard (Tab 6)
Contractor documentation: Request disposal certificates/manifests from contractor for every collection. File and retain for 3 years
column8: Documentation received for at least 2 consecutive collections

column4: Food waste (F&B): Begin weekly food waste tracking by source using Tab 5. Identify top waste source in Week 1
Food waste reduction: Implement FIFO storage checks daily. Designate a staff member responsible for daily stock rotation
column8: FIFO checklist completed daily for 2 consecutive weeks

column4: Single-use plastic: Audit single-use plastic items in use. Identify 1–2 items to replace with reusable alternatives in 90 days
column8: At least 1 single-use plastic item replaced
